name: ak-auto
concurrency: group: ak-auto-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.pr || github.event.pull_request.number }}

name: ak-commands
concurrency: group: ak-commands-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.pr || github.event.issue.number || github.event.pull_request.number }}-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.command || 'cmd' }}

name: ak-exec
concurrency: group: ak-exec-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.pr || github.event.issue.number }}-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.command || 'cmd' }}
